'''S'ran Droot''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Chief Petty Officer/Legends|Chief Petty Officer]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. While assigned to the [[Port Heavy Blaster Station]] of the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial-class Star Destroyer]] [[Steel Talon/Legends|''Steel Talon'']] prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he shared quarters with [[Tenn Graneet]]. As a [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]], he was one of few non-[[Human/Legends|Humans]] to achieve any rank in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="DSn" />
